verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents a "customizable hosted UI for authentication" (AuthKit), and its React SDK "handles sign-in, sign-up, token refresh, and session management via a hosted OAuth flow." Framework SDKs reinforce this: Astro ships auth components and Laravel starter kits have AuthKit built in. missing for 10: evidence of prebuilt profile/account-management UI, detail on the depth of hosted-page customization, independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted UI.
